English: Chuck and the Rancher's ranged abilities have been deactived.

Disable Special Attack takes the ranged special abilities away from two zombies - Chuck and the Rancher - so both of them have to close the distance and fight you in melee like every other zombie.

Chuck normally tears a boulder loose and hurls it at you from across the street. The Rancher normally spits out a swarm of insects that chases you down. Both attacks reach you long before the zombie itself does, and both are hard to read and harder to dodge in a fight that is already crowded.

With this installed, neither one has anything to throw. They still spawn, still hunt, still hit hard in melee, and are otherwise entirely unchanged - they simply have to arrive first.

Nothing else in the game is affected. No other enemy, no loot, no spawning, no gamestage or difficulty.

The abilities are removed in two places each, because a special attack in this game exists on both sides of the fence: the AI has to decide to use it, and the zombie's weapon has to be able to perform it.

AI SIDE. The ranged attack task is stripped from Chuck's and the Rancher's AI task lists, so neither one ever chooses to attack from a distance. Without it they fall through to their normal approach and melee behaviour.

WEAPON SIDE. The secondary attack is removed from the invisible hand item each of them carries - Chuck's boulder throw and the Rancher's insect swarm - so the attack cannot fire even if something else were to ask for it. Every variant of those hand items is covered, not just the base one.

What is deliberately left alone: their health, damage, speed, resistances, sounds, animations, feral and radiated variants, spawn rates and where they appear. This is not a difficulty reduction pass on either zombie - it removes one attack apiece and stops there.

A loading screen tip is added as a reminder that the modlet is active.

XML ONLY. The modlet ships no assembly, so it runs with Easy Anti-Cheat enabled and needs no special launch options.

SERVER AND CLIENT. It edits entity and item definitions, which both sides read. On a dedicated server install it on the server, and have players install the same copy so their configuration matches.

SAFE TO ADD MID SAVE. Existing worlds and existing zombies pick up the change on load - there is no need to start a new save.

REMOVING IT restores both attacks immediately on the next load, with no leftover state in your save.

If a Chuck or a Rancher still throws something at you, another modlet loading after this one has most likely re-added the attack, or the pair are being spawned from a class this modlet does not name. Load order is alphabetical by folder name, so a modlet sorting later wins.
